body.en:
Dear, Unknown,

I don't know where you are anymore.

So I sent one to every place
I thought you might be.

— M
body.zh_CN:
亲爱的陌生人：

我已经不知道你在哪里了。

所以我往每一个
你可能在的地方都寄了一张。

—— M

notes: Ate standing up at a counter built for six. Best meal of the trip.
Got lost in a train station for twenty minutes and enjoyed all of it.
It rained the whole afternoon and somehow that improved things.
Bought coffee from a vending machine. It was genuinely good.
Quieter than you would ever guess from the photos.
Wish you were here.
No news. Just this.
Saved you the good half of the postcard.
Thinking of you from a long way away.
Nothing to report except that it was lovely.

body.en:
Dear, Unknown,
Most of the trees were already bare.
Then I saw one.
A single cherry blossom above the pond.
It was the most beautiful shade of pink.
I wish you could have seen it.
— M
body.zh_CN:
亲爱的陌生人：
树差不多都空了。
然后我看见一朵。
池塘上方，只有那一朵樱花。
那是我见过最好看的粉色。
真希望你也能看见。
—— M

cities.style: Makoto Shinkai — luminous dusk, lens flare, saturated sky

notes: Sat at a tiny table watching people for an hour. That was the activity.
The bread really is different here. I am sorry to report it.
Walked until my feet hurt, then walked a bit more.
Everything shut for lunch and honestly I respect it.
Found a bench with a good view and stayed there far too long.
Wish you were here.
No news. Just this.
Saved you the good half of the postcard.
Thinking of you from a long way away.
Nothing to report except that it was lovely.

body.en:
Dear, Unknown,
I found a little boulangerie this morning.
The baker said it was the last one.
It was still warm,
so I ate it by the window
with a coffee and the sound of bicycles outside.
I thought about saving half for you.
I didn't.
I'm sorry.
— M
body.zh_CN:
亲爱的陌生人：
今天早上我找到一家很小的面包店。
面包师说这是最后一只了。
它还是热的，
所以我就在窗边把它吃了，
配一杯咖啡，还有窗外自行车的声音。
我想过给你留一半。
我没有。
对不起。
—— M

cities.style: Monet — impressionist broken colour, diffuse gold light

notes: There is a ruin behind the bus stop and nobody looks at it.
Ate far too much and would do the whole thing again.
The water from the street fountains is freezing and free.
Got lost on purpose. Can recommend.
Everything here is older than it strictly needs to be.
Wish you were here.
No news. Just this.
Saved you the good half of the postcard.
Thinking of you from a long way away.
Nothing to report except that it was lovely.

body.en:
Dear, Unknown,
An old woman gave me a coin today.
She was sitting beside the fountain,
while the water glittered with hundreds of other coins.
She told me it was the last one.
I asked her what she meant.
“The last coin,” she said.
I asked what it was worth.
She smiled.
“Nothing anymore.”
Then she put it in my hand and walked away.
I still have it.
— M
body.zh_CN:
亲爱的陌生人：
今天有位老太太给了我一枚硬币。
她坐在喷泉边上，
水里还闪着另外几百枚。
她说这是最后一枚。
我问她这话什么意思。
“最后一枚硬币。”她说。
我问它值多少。
她笑了。
“已经什么都不值了。”
然后她把它放进我手里，走了。
我还留着。
—— M

cities.style: Caravaggio — tenebrism, deep shadow, one hard light source

notes: Loud in a way that stops bothering you after about a day.
Walked eleven miles without meaning to.
The pizza argument is real and I have now picked a side.
Looked up constantly for a week. Nobody else does.
Bought something from a cart at midnight. No regrets.
Wish you were here.
No news. Just this.
Saved you the good half of the postcard.
Thinking of you from a long way away.
Nothing to report except that it was lovely.

body.en:
Dear, Unknown,
I met a man in a diner last night.
He was sitting alone by the window,
watching the yellow cabs pass by.
We talked until they started closing.
Before I left, I asked why he came there every night.
He said,
“So I don't have to be alone.”
I thought that was strange.
He was alone the whole time.
— M
body.zh_CN:
亲爱的陌生人：
昨天晚上我在一家小餐馆遇到一个人。
他一个人坐在窗边，
看着黄色的出租车开过去。
我们一直聊到店里开始打烊。
临走前我问他，为什么每天晚上都来这儿。
他说：
“这样我就不用一个人了。”
我觉得这话很奇怪。
他明明一直都是一个人。
—— M

cities.style: Edward Hopper — flat planes of hard light, still and empty

notes: Rained. Went to a pub instead. The system works.
Sat in a park in the gap between two rain showers.
The tube map is a lie about geography and I love it.
Everyone apologised to me and I apologised straight back.
The museums are free, so I went to three of them.
Wish you were here.
No news. Just this.
Saved you the good half of the postcard.
Thinking of you from a long way away.
Nothing to report except that it was lovely.

body.en:
Dear, Unknown,
London has been grey for days.
The sky never seems to change.
Even the afternoons feel like evenings.
I haven't heard from you in a long time.
I used to think you were busy.
Then I thought maybe you didn't want to write back.
Today, I don't feel like guessing anymore.
So I think this will be the last postcard I send you.
I hope you're well.
— M
body.zh_CN:
亲爱的陌生人：
伦敦已经灰了好几天。
天空好像从来不变。
连下午都像傍晚。
我很久没有收到你的消息了。
以前我以为你只是忙。
后来我想，也许你不想回信。
今天，我不想再猜了。
所以我想，这大概是我寄给你的最后一张明信片。
希望你一切都好。
—— M

cities.style: Victorian pale watercolour — soft washes, muted, restrained

notes: Wish you were here.
No news. Just this.
Saved you the good half of the postcard.
Thinking of you from a long way away.
Nothing to report except that it was lovely.

body.en:
Dear, Unknown,
I came to Kyoto for the cherry blossoms.
Last year, I remember them in Tokyo.
The crowds, the cameras,
the pink everywhere.
But Kyoto feels like an ordinary day.
No crowds.
No blossoms.
Even the little Hello Kitty in the shop window
is black now.
I asked the girl behind the counter why.
She laughed.
“Black is in this year.”
I suppose that's a good enough reason.
— M
body.zh_CN:
亲爱的陌生人：
我为了樱花来京都。
去年，我记得东京的樱花。
人群，相机，
到处都是粉色。
但京都像是平常的一天。
没有人群。
没有花。
连店铺橱窗里那只小 Hello Kitty
现在都是黑色的。
我问柜台后面的女孩为什么。
她笑了。
“今年流行黑色。”
我想这理由也够了。
—— M

cities.style: Hasui Kawase — shin-hanga, still water, lantern light

notes: Wish you were here.
No news. Just this.
Saved you the good half of the postcard.
Thinking of you from a long way away.
Nothing to report except that it was lovely.

body.en:
Dear, Unknown,
I found a little bakery this morning.
I asked for a croissant.
The baker looked at me strangely.
“We don't make those.”
Apparently, everyone here prefers sourdough now.
I told him I didn't like sourdough.
You never did either.
You always said it was too heavy,
and ordered a croissant instead.
I asked if he knew where I could find one.
He said I was probably thinking of something else.
Maybe I am.
I left without one.
— M
body.zh_CN:
亲爱的陌生人：
今天早上我找到一家很小的面包店。
我要了一只可颂。
面包师奇怪地看着我。
“我们不做那个。”
好像这里的人现在都更喜欢酸面包。
我告诉他我不喜欢酸面包。
你以前也不喜欢。
你总说那个太沉了，
然后点一只可颂。
我问他知不知道哪里能买到。
他说我大概是记错了别的东西。
也许我是记错了。
我什么都没买就走了。
—— M

cities.style: Richard Diebenkorn — flat bay light, hard-edged colour fields

notes: Wish you were here.
No news. Just this.
Saved you the good half of the postcard.
Thinking of you from a long way away.
Nothing to report except that it was lovely.

body.en:
Dear, Unknown,
I tried to use the coin today.
The cashier looked at it
as if I had handed him a button.
“Sorry,” he said.
“We don't take those.”
I told him it was money.
He smiled.
“Not anymore.”
Everyone pays with their phones now.
I suppose he's right.
I put the coin back in my pocket.
It feels strange to carry something
everyone has forgotten how to use.
— M
body.zh_CN:
亲爱的陌生人：
今天我想把那枚硬币用掉。
收银员看着它，
好像我递给他的是一颗纽扣。
“抱歉，”他说，
“我们不收这个。”
我说这是钱。
他笑了。
“已经不是了。”
现在大家都用手机付钱。
我想他是对的。
我把硬币放回口袋。
带着一件所有人都不会用了的东西，
感觉很奇怪。
—— M

cities.style: Iznik ceramic — turquoise and cobalt on white, patterned

notes: Wish you were here.
No news. Just this.
Saved you the good half of the postcard.
Thinking of you from a long way away.
Nothing to report except that it was lovely.

body.en:
Dear, Unknown,
I met someone today who lives alone.
She told me she likes it that way.
I asked if she ever gets lonely.
She looked confused.
“Why would I?”
She said she has books,
music,
the sea,
and plenty of things to do.
I didn't know what to say.
Maybe she's right.
Maybe being alone
isn't the same as being lonely.
I still miss you.
— M
body.zh_CN:
亲爱的陌生人：
今天我遇到一个独自生活的人。
她说她喜欢这样。
我问她会不会觉得孤独。
她一脸困惑。
“我为什么会孤独？”
她说她有书，
有音乐，
有海，
还有很多事情可以做。
我不知道该说什么。
也许她是对的。
也许一个人
和孤独并不是一回事。
我还是想你。
—— M

cities.style: Northern night — low sun, long shadow, aurora over snow

notes: Wish you were here.
No news. Just this.
Saved you the good half of the postcard.
Thinking of you from a long way away.
Nothing to report except that it was lovely.

body.en:
Dear, Unknown,
I came to Bermuda today.
Someone told me about the Triangle.
Ships disappear. Planes disappear.
We always seem to find a reason.
Things have been changing lately.
Maybe I'm the only one who notices.
I wrote some of them down.
I'm glad I did.
I don't know why.
So I'll keep writing.
Just in case.
— M
body.zh_CN:
亲爱的陌生人：
今天我到了百慕大。
有人跟我说起那个三角。
船会消失。飞机会消失。
我们好像总能找到一个解释。
最近有些东西在变。
也许只有我一个人注意到。
我把其中一些写了下来。
我很庆幸我写了。
我不知道为什么。
所以我会继续写。
以防万一。
—— M

cities.style: Winslow Homer — watercolour, sunlight through shallow water
